notes.title: Join our e-mail newsletter!
notes.notes:
The e-mail newsletter is the easiest way to keep up to date with all thats happening with Little Oceania.  We'll send updates for things like demos, new trailers, festival participation, etc.

[url=https://blueoystergames.com/]Newsletter link[/url]

notes.title: We have a Discord 🚀
notes.notes:
We've started a Discord community, and would love for you to get involved!  We'll be posting early screenshots and videos as development progresses, as well as holding alpha testing for Discord members.  We're also open to all feedback and would love to hear your suggestions.  Come on in!

[url=https://discord.gg/KyHDmazyYa]Discord Link[/url]
